# Branches fixtures

Live sanitized capture: **2026-10-28**, generated by
`tool/branch_department_capture.dart`.

## Live fixtures

- `branches_list.json` — page 1, pageSize 25, sort nameAsc; 6 rows.
- `branches_list_filtered.json` — `status=Active`, pageSize 5; 5 rows.
- `branch_detail.json` — branch 2, full detail including IANA `timeZoneId`.
- `branch_not_found.json` — `BRANCH_NOT_FOUND`.
- `branch_lookups.json` — divisions, statuses, yes/no, timeZones.
- `branches_forbidden.json` — employee account, `ACCESS_DENIED`.

## Observed contract

- List/detail names are sanitized to `Branch <id>`; contact/email/mobile/address
  and person names are replaced. Timezone ids remain real IANA ids.
- Detail adds `trn`, `logoPath`, `arabicLogoPath`, `labourCode`,
  `tradeLicense`, `createdBy`, `createdOn`, `updatedBy`, `updatedOn`; several
  are nullable.
- Lookups expose IANA timezone ids plus display names and UTC offsets.
- Login `branches[]` contains the same 6 ids as `/api/branches`, while the
  login `orgCount` is 9. `branches[]` is therefore not the authoritative full
  list; every branch selector must use `/api/branches`.
- No live writes were sent. Create/update bodies must include an IANA
  `timeZoneId` from `branch_lookups.json`; other shapes follow audit/Postman.
